accountNumber.description: Number of the account to which the statement information relates to. Account number must be between 16 and 19 digits. TPP clients must send encrypted Account number field

currencyCode.description:
3-character alpha currency code

Applicable for dual currency accounts

languageCode.description:
Returns the merchant name value in the respective language

Eg.
EN for English
JA for Japanese.If an invalid language is provided, the response will default with English language
